title: Social Progress Index 2026: health, housing, rights and opportunity
discussion_signal: The discussion presents social progress as an outcome framework covering health, education, rights, housing, environment, and opportunity, intended to reveal communities left behind by income measures alone.
linked_research_question: How is global social progress approaching a turning point as rights decline and gains in health, housing, information, and environmental quality stall or reverse?
limits: The post describes the index rather than providing causal analysis
Composite indicators depend on measurement and weighting choices
The discussion does not establish which policies produce observed outcomes
